podcast.title: American Alt Rock Contribution
podcast.body: The punk rock revival is identified as one of the main American contributions to Alt Rock in the 1990s, alongside grunge. "If the main American contributions to Alt Rock were grunge in the punk rock revival, and if the UK's was Britpop, ours was Can Rock."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Indie Artist Boost
podcast.body: The mid-90s punk rock revival in North America received a significant boost from indie artists, who had been instrumental in nurturing this genre for years, especially in California. "The area that got a big boost from indie artists was the mid-90s punk rock revival in North America."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Major Label Shift from Grunge
podcast.body: By 1995, as grunge largely came under major label control, these major labels, having recognized the long-standing alternative music scene, began actively scouting independent labels for new punk rock acts, particularly those emerging from California. "By 1995, but with a few exceptions, Grunge had largely come under the control of the majors. The trail led to some new punk rock that was being made, especially in California, and it just made sense to start scouring the indie labels that have been nurturing this stuff for years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Overshadowing Dreampop (1990s)
podcast.body: The punk rock revival is cited as one of the musical trends of the 1990s that contributed to Dreampop being overshadowed and relegated to the margins of popular music.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
